scope: Additional public-data leads found after the primary-source refresh

sources.title: Operational Data List of Hydrogen Refueling Stations for Beijing Winter Olympics
sources.reported_coverage: 2022 HRS monitoring, fueling records and compressor monitoring; catalog metadata reports four files and approximately 10.22 MB.
sources.next_action: Request the four files, channel dictionary, timestamp synchronization, vehicle/receptacle pressure and temperature mapping, calibration/quality flags and written reuse terms before protocol freeze.

sources.title: 70 MPa hydrogenation-port test dataset
sources.reported_coverage: Component test data for a 70 MPa vehicle hydrogenation port; catalog metadata reports 15 files and 73.94 MB.
sources.finding: Useful for connector/seal/port boundary checks, but it does not represent a complete station-to-vehicle fueling trajectory.

sources.title: Experimental–numerical optimization of inlet angles for controlling temperature rise during high-flow hydrogen refueling of large-scale storage tanks
sources.reported_coverage: 35 MPa high-flow tank experiments with time-resolved mass-flow boundary data and thermocouple temperature measurements.
sources.next_action: Request de-identified synchronized mass-flow, pressure, gas-temperature and wall/thermocouple files, geometry, calibration metadata and reuse permission.

sources.title: Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling
sources.reported_coverage: One year of Cal State LA Hydrogen Research and Fueling Facility operation, including back-to-back events, storage pressure, cooling response, thermodynamics and vehicle SOC.
sources.next_action: Request the synchronized logger export, vehicle/receptacle pressure and temperature channels, station control states, calibration metadata, event identifiers and written reuse terms before protocol freeze.

sources.title: Data-Driven Intelligent Analysis System for Monitoring and Anomaly Detection in Hydrogen Refueling Station
sources.reported_coverage: BAM demonstration HRS monitoring with pressure, temperature and flow-rate sensors, field integration and performance testing.
sources.data_availability_statement: Original contributions are included in the article; further inquiries are directed to the corresponding author.
sources.next_action: Request de-identified synchronized raw sensor and controller logs, channel dictionary, quality flags, calibration records, event labels and reuse permission.

claim_boundary: A public catalog record, paper statement or component test is not promoted to numerical full-loop validation without downloadable synchronized raw files, immutable hashes, independent protocol freeze and written reuse rights.
